exposure: cesarean section following attempted vacuum extraction
cohort: 1,030,775 infants born at >36 completed weeks in Sweden from 1999 to 2012
finding: The odds ratios for neonatal complications increased at higher birthweights among infants born after vacuum extraction with or without cesarean section and vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Vacuum extraction is a risk factor for serious neonatal complications, in particular when used in macrosomic fetuses.
